notes:
Nintendo JP Switch 2 「機能・仕様」 page, Joy-Con 2 spec table (one サイズ cell spans the (L) and (R) columns). Axis mapping as Nintendo labels it: 縦116mm = height, 横41.4mm = width, 厚さ30.7mm = depth. The ※ footnote under the size says the 30.7 mm thickness is the maximum from the analogue stick tip to the ZL/ZR projection, so the envelope INCLUDES projections at least in depth: excludes_projections=false. CONFLICT NOT FILED: Nintendo's AU tech-specs page prints «Approx. 116mm x 14.4mm x 30.7mm» with unlabelled axes; 14.4 vs the JP page's labelled 横41.4mm looks like a digit transposition on the AU page, but since the AU triple carries no axis labels it cannot be a candidate for width, so it is recorded here only (a human should compare the en-gb page). Mass: the JP page gives the standard model only; the UK page also lists a user-replaceable-battery variant (68 g / 69 g), not filed. split=magnetic_halves from 「磁石を使った、Joy-Con 2 を本体に取り付けるための機構です。」 (the console's attach mechanism) — also the source for host_console. wired=false (Bluetooth row); cell_kind=built_in (内蔵バッテリー row, 500mAh, not user-removable); cell_count null. ports [] = unknown: the spec table has no 端子 (port) row for the Joy-Con 2; the charging contacts on the rail are not a contract kind. Mouse sensor, NFC (R), HD振動2 have no kind. Control mapping: 上／下／左／右 on the (L) are four discrete directional buttons, filed as face_button 4 (they are laid out like a face-button diamond; a cross dpad would misstate the part); L/R = bumper 1; ZL/ZR = trigger 1; SL/SR = side_button 2 (on the rail face); stick 1 (the stick button is its click, not a separate control); 取り外しボタン (release) and シンクロボタン (sync) counted under button with the system buttons, as Nintendo lists them in its ボタン row. released not on this page (null). (L) column: mass 約66g; ボタン: Lスティック／Lスティックボタン; 上／下／左／右／L／ZL／SL／SR／-ボタン; キャプチャーボタン; 取り外しボタン; シンクロボタン → button 4 = −, capture, release, sync. The (L) communication cell reads «Bluetooth» alone; its own cell is quoted for wired=false, rather than borrowing the (R) Bluetooth/NFC cell. The 上／下／左／右／L… run is split by a
in the HTML; the quote is its text with the tag removed.
